✓ Fractional-reserve banking.fact: Fractional-reserve banking is the system of banking under which banks that take deposits from the public keep only part of their deposit liabilities in liquid assets as a reserve, and lend a percentage to borrowers, thus having the effect of increasing the money supply by the loaned amount.
